changelog.title: Product URL Slugs
changelog.summary: Clean, readable URLs for every product page instead of cryptic MongoDB IDs.

after.label: Auto-generated slug + admin can customise
points: Auto-generated from product name on create
Admin can override with any custom slug
Inline edit right from the product table

changelog.title: Coupon Code System
changelog.summary: Full coupon management — create, edit, bulk delete, and apply codes at checkout.

after.label: Admin CRUD with full validation
points: Expiry date, usage limits, min order amount

changelog.title: Category Hierarchy
changelog.summary: Subcategory support — products can belong to a parent and a child category.

after.label: Parent → Subcategory tree
points: Subcategory dropdown appears when parent has children

changelog.title: Admin → User Messaging
changelog.summary: Admin replies to contact messages are delivered to the user's profile inbox.

before.label: One-way contact form only
before.code: Contact form → DB → Admin reads → dead end

after.label: Two-way with unread badges
after.code:
Admin replies → userRead: false
Profile "My Messages" shows 🔵 badge
points: Admin types reply in admin panel
User sees unread badge on Profile sidebar
Thread expands to show all replies
Auto-marked read when user opens the message

changelog.title: Secure User Data Page
changelog.summary: Password-locked admin page showing user emails, bcrypt hashes, and password reset.

before.label: No way to inspect or reset user credentials
before.code: // No endpoint for admin password ops
points: Could not see which users existed
No admin password reset for users

changelog.title: Orders Page — Column Toggles & Search
changelog.summary: User orders page rebuilt with search, sort, column visibility, and status filters.

after.label: Full table with toolbar
after.code:
Columns: Items | Total | Payment | Status | Date
Search by Order ID or item name
points: Sort by date, total, or status
Status tabs: All / Pending / Shipped / Delivered…

changelog.title: Bulk User Activate / Deactivate
changelog.summary: Select multiple users and activate or deactivate them in one click.

before.label: Toggle one user at a time
points: Had to edit each user individually

after.label: Checkbox multi-select + bulk bar
points: Checkbox per row + select all on page

changelog.title: Bulk Category Actions
changelog.summary: Bulk activate, deactivate, or delete multiple categories at once.

before.label: Edit / delete one category at a time

after.label: Checkbox + bulk action bar
points: Activate / Deactivate / Delete in one action

changelog.title: Coupon Import / Export
changelog.summary: Coupons added to the Import/Export system alongside products, users, etc.

after.label: Full coupon support in data bundle
after.code:
bundle = { ..., coupons: [...] }
CSV fields: code, discountType, discountValue, ...
points: Export coupons as JSON or CSV

changelog.title: Request Logs Now Show Email & Username
changelog.summary: Server request logs now resolve and display the user's email and name instead of a raw user ID.

before.label: Raw user ID in every log line
points: Log lines only showed the MongoDB user ID
Had to manually look up which user an ID belonged to
Hard to audit who performed an action at a glance

after.label: Email + name resolved per request, with caching
points: Log lines now show "email (name)" instead of a raw ID
In-memory cache (5 min TTL) avoids a DB hit on every request
Makes server/logs/YYYY-MM-DD.log files human-readable for auditing
